caption: The status bar shows the reading time of the open note.
eval: const e = app.workspace.activeEditor.editor; e.setCursor({ line: 0, ch: 0 }); e.scrollTo(0, 0); 'ok'

caption: With text selected, the status bar times only the selection.
eval: const e = app.workspace.activeEditor.editor; let i = 0; while (i < e.lineCount() && !e.getLine(i).startsWith('Once I had')) i++; e.focus(); e.setSelection({ line: i, ch: 0 }, { line: i + 3, ch: 0 }); e.scrollIntoView({ from: { line: i - 3, ch: 0 }, to: { line: i + 6, ch: 0 } }, true); 'ok'
